<article class="entry">
  <header class="entry-header wrap wrap--prose">
    <p class="entry-kicker"><a href="&#x2f;category&#x2f;guides&#x2f;">Guides</a></p>
    <h1 class="entry-title">Media and image variants</h1>
    <p class="entry-meta byline"><span class="avatar" aria-hidden="true">S</span><span class="entry-meta__author">by <a class="author" href="/author/admin/" rel="author">Site Admin</a></span><time datetime="<date>"><date></time><span class="entry-meta__reading">1 min read</span>
    </p>
  </header>
  
<figure class="entry-hero wrap wrap--wide">
  <img src="&#x2f;_media&#x2f;<hash>&#x2f;sample-gradient.png" alt="An orange to violet gradient" width="1280" height="640" srcset="&#x2f;_media&#x2f;<hash>&#x2f;sample-gradient.png 1280w" sizes="(min-width: 66rem) 62rem, 100vw" decoding="async" fetchpriority="high">
</figure>
  <div class="entry-body wrap">
    <div class="entry-content prose">
      <p>Uploads are stored by content hash, and every image gets resized variants for themes to use.</p><h2 id="what-you-get">What you get</h2><ul><li><p>A single binary and a single data folder</p></li><li><p>Plugins in a capability-scoped sandbox</p></li><li><p>Themes that are templates, not programs</p></li></ul><p>Try it on your own machine:</p><pre tabindex="0"><code class="language-sh">ferrite init --data ./site --url http://localhost:8080
ferrite seed demo --data ./site
ferrite serve --data ./site</code></pre><blockquote><p>Plugins are untrusted. They get only what their manifest declares.</p></blockquote><p>Read more in <a href="/about/">the about page</a>.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
  <footer class="entry-footer wrap wrap--prose">
